summary: The legal array length is capped at 100 elements, which is too small for a stable runtime-scaling distinction among sorting and alternative top-k selection methods.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 1 <= n == nums.length <= 100, with 1 <= k <= n and every value positive

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation performs at most 100 expected-time set insertions, sorts at most U <= 100 distinct values, and slices at most k <= 100 outputs, establishing O(n + U log U) time.

The certificate regression checks 112,305 exhaustive array-and-k cases over values 1 through 5 at lengths 1 through 6, then 5,000 deterministic legal arrays spanning every length through 100 and explicit extrema against repeated maximum selection.
